# Muhammad Huzaifa Shafique

> Graduated in December 2026 with a Master of Science in Technology with an emphasis in AI from Pittsburg State University (GPA 4.0), looking for AI and machine learning engineer roles. Builds retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), forecasting, ML-pipeline and neural-network systems in Python, tests them against baselines, and states where they fall short.

- Site: https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-huzaifa-shafique

## Main projects

- [Casefile: Local RAG System](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/casefile.html): A local RAG system that answers questions from public penetration-testing documentation (HackTricks wiki and tool manual pages) and cites its sources. 22,720 chunks, three embedding setups (nomic-embed-text, nomic-embed-text with prefixes, all-minilm) in Chroma, Llama 3.1 8B served by Ollama, and a citation checker with 58 unit tests. Limits: seven test questions, no answer key, answer quality not measured end to end. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifa-Shafique/Casefile-Local-RAG-System
- [CyberAI: Threat Triage ML Pipeline](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/cyberai.html): An applied ML project with cyber-threat triage as the test domain. A rule-based baseline whose offline rules run live in the browser (https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/cyberai.html#try), tested against the Python code on 28,600 cases with no differences; a scikit-learn pipeline (logistic regression, Isolation Forest anomaly detection, elastic-net risk score) with a drift monitor and a human-review queue; and a retrieval assistant that cites its evidence (TF-IDF retrieval; a MiniLM embedding index was built, but the chat does not use it in this version). Limits: no saved evaluation, and the saved training data (25 malicious file hashes, 425 unlabeled text records) cannot support a meaningful test, so no accuracy is claimed; the full pipeline source is not published yet. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifa-Shafique/CyberAI-Threat-Triage-ML-Pipeline
- [Sales Forecasting Neural Network](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/forecasting.html): A scikit-learn MLPRegressor that forecasts monthly sales for ten items, tested against four baselines on 12 unseen months with MAE, RMSE, WAPE and bias. WAPE 78.7% against 89.6% for the best baseline (about 12% lower). Five model versions, one rejected. Limits: bias of -37% over the test year, one hold-out period, ten items. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifa-Shafique/Sales-Forecasting-Neural-Network
- [Gapminder Interactive Dashboard](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/dashboard.html): An animated Quarto, R and Plotly report on life expectancy and income in 142 countries, 1952 to 2007, with population-weighted continent averages and a log income scale. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifa-Shafique/Gapminder-Interactive-Dashboard

## Deep learning

- [Neural Networks: From Scratch to CNNs](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/deep-learning.html): An interactive walkthrough of four graduate neural-network assignments. (1) A 3-4-4-1 network's forward pass in NumPy. (2) Backpropagation written by hand with a 500-epoch gradient-descent loop on 100 synthetic samples: training loss falls from 796.2 to 23.5, after a long flat start at the variance of the targets and a one-epoch spike at epoch 121. (3) Ten one-change Keras experiments on California housing prices, each kept only if validation MAPE improved: test MAPE 21.33% to 18.91%. (4) Ten convolutional-network variations on CIFAR-10: test accuracy 71.65% to 74.54%. Limits: course exercises on standard datasets; each Keras result is a single training run; assignment 4 has no validation set, so its best score is probably a little optimistic; the Keras numbers are copied from the submitted reports. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifa-Shafique/Neural-Networks-From-Scratch-to-CNNs

## Data engineering

- [Oklahoma Legislature Vote Extractor](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/data-engineering.html): Python (asyncio, aiohttp, regular expressions, pandas) tool that collects House and Senate votes into three CSV files. Team project in a graduate course; my part was the House votes. Checks on the House output (30,475 votes, 1999 to 2025): seat counts add up to the size of the House, but member rows cover only 76% of counted seats, and the cause is not yet traced. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifa-Shafique/Oklahoma-Legislature-Vote-Extractor
- [Fixed-Width Data Extractor](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/data-engineering.html#fixed): Turns fixed-width text reports into clean Excel tables. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifa-Shafique/Fixed-Width-Data-Extractor

## How I work with AI

- [Prompts, checks and disclosure](https://muhammad-huzaifa-shafique.github.io/method.html): Four real prompts from my projects, line by line, with what each line is for and what checks it, plus how I use AI assistants when I write code and reports. I have not compared prompt wordings against a scored test set.

## Skills

- Machine learning and LLMs: scikit-learn (neural networks, logistic regression, Isolation Forest), time-series feature engineering, model evaluation (MAE, RMSE, WAPE, MAPE, bias, baselines, hold-out tests), anomaly detection, drift monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings and vector search (Chroma, MiniLM, nomic-embed-text), TF-IDF retrieval, prompt engineering, citation checking, local LLMs (Ollama, Llama 3.1).
- Deep learning: neural networks, forward propagation and backpropagation written in NumPy, gradient descent, regression and convolutional neural networks (CNN) in Keras and TensorFlow, early stopping, dropout, batch normalization, learning-rate schedules, data augmentation, hyperparameter experiments, CIFAR-10 image classification.
- Python and data: Python, pandas, NumPy, SQL, SQLite, R, Quarto, Plotly, REST APIs, Flask, asyncio, unit testing, Git.
- Security (the domain of two projects): penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, threat intelligence, Kali Linux, Nmap, Metasploit.
